title: Wanting to play guitar
summary: He tried guitar and would have liked the chord style of Charlie Christian.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Did you ever play any other instruments that came?

Well, I tried the guitar, but I never could make it. I played a few chords on it. I loved guitar, and I wanted to take lessons, but I never did get around to it. But that was my next instrument, if I was, you know, I just loved that instrument, but I never did get around to it.
What kind of guitar did you like? Did you like chords, the lead, or picking?

Well, I didn't play with it long enough to remember myself with what style I would like. But I just liked it, period, to get there. But I think I would prefer the chord style, something like a Charlie Christian style. I see Pixie a lot too, but I read it in the chord style.
